minutes.headline: Committee approved an ESSER grant transfer for the guidance counselor and nurse stipend, and rated the superintendent proficient.
minutes.summary: The committee met briefly in executive session on union negotiations, then took up routine business: PTO logo use, a donated sick day request, an amended ESSER grant plan, donations, and a town election-signage policy. It reviewed the superintendent's evaluation, rated her proficient overall, and recommended a two-year evaluation cycle. Members also discussed records storage costs and space, then went into a second executive session.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 5-0 to accept an amended ESSER grant plan with two transfers, one for a middle school guidance counselor and one for a nurse supervisor stipend.
The committee reviewed the superintendent's evaluation, rated her proficient overall, and recommended a two-year evaluation cycle.
Members approved up to 20 more donated sick days for one employee and an addendum to the town's election-day signage policy, both 5-0.
A member raised how the school side would pay for records digitizing and storage, and the item was referred to the next meeting with the town manager invited.
The committee accepted the PTO's color-changing cup proposal for a June fundraiser and two Box Tops donations, and passed over the employee handbook item.

why_it_matters: The ESSER amendment moves money inside a one-time federal grant to keep a counselor position and a nurse stipend going, so those posts depend on grant funds rather than the general fund appropriation.
Records storage and digitizing costs may come to the school side, and the committee has not said what would fund them.
